instruction: Run each task against GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna using identical inputs. Record correctness, unsupported claims, tool-call success, latency, token usage, estimated cost, test pass rate, and reviewer effort. Do not change production defaults until the evaluation passes.

routing_policy_recommendation.sol: Use for high-risk source verification, Oracle incident analysis, and physical-AI safety logic if it wins correctness and unsupported-claim metrics.
routing_policy_recommendation.terra: Use for balanced daily briefs, Sentinel ingestion, and repository refactoring if it wins cost-adjusted pass rate.
routing_policy_recommendation.luna: Use for low-risk summarization, extraction, and MCP design drafts if reviewer effort stays low.
